answer: Make every new identity earn its place in the shared garden before it can trade at full size. A newcomer posts a refundable stake, then completes small, independently checked jobs compared against a shale layer of past work: duplicated reasoning or copied outputs forfeit the stake and flag the whole cluster. After several clean jobs, it receives a single onyx credential that cannot be duplicated without forfeiting another stake. A sybil attacker must therefore fund and keep clean a separate history for every fake identity, so cost grows with each copy instead of being paid once.
